criteria.outcome: One shared guide mechanism and its wording slots apply to all four products without changing semantic content, candidate semantics, emphasis policy, or authority direction.
With JavaScript enabled, the overlay opens on load and presents the product-kind-correct profile: Profile S for specification products, Profile P for prior-art products.
The persistent masthead Guide control reopens the overlay after dismissal; focus is contained while open and returns to the invoking control on close.
Escape, backdrop activation, and the explicit close control each dismiss the overlay without semantic-state, emphasis, navigation, or scroll-owner change.
With JavaScript removed, no overlay appears and the guide content remains readable in document order through the in-document carrier at the applicable typography tiers.
Print output contains no overlay and no guide content, while required masthead, legal, cautionary, and profile wording continues to print.

Overlay and carrier content respect the controlled measure and survive 200% text resize, 200% page zoom, the 320 CSS-pixel reflow, and the text-spacing override without clipping, overlap, or page-level horizontal scrolling; reduced motion disables entry animation.
Every guide string resolves from a consumed, typed, exactly-sourced wording slot; no hardcoded, unused, or unresolved slot exists.
The guide is stateless: no storage is read or written, the overlay opens on every load, and candidate and sealed reproduction remain byte-stable.

The contract pair, registry, browser control, renderer, wording, exact verifier census, runbook, four candidates, four sealed products, checksums, bundle, and governed path census form one deterministic retained current state.
